summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine capital increase from the exercise of 22,666 Restricted Share Units under its incentive program. New shares were issued in cash at DKK 139.90 and DKK 195.50 per share, totaling a nominal increase of USD 226.66. This is a standard equity compensation settlement, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or strategic implications are involved. The filing is routine and administrative, with no risk-arb or deal angle to monitor.
